B01.reason: Runtime explicitly marks generative AI unavailable until a safe provider is configured.

B02.reason: No audio-aware generative section replacement operation exists in the current runtime.

B03.reason: Lyrics can be edited as text, but there is no local audio lyric replacement operation.

B04.reason: Runtime explicitly marks vocal conversion unavailable; no identity-preserving regeneration exists.

B05.reason: PT-BR lyric analysis exists, but no sung-vocal generation exists locally.

B06.reason: Semitone detune/pitch shift exists, but it is not note-aware correction and the UI explicitly warns that pitch changes duration; no formant preservation.

B07.reason: A 22 ms / +11 cent double layer exists, but there is no musically generated high/low harmony engine.

B08.reason: Mixer and effects can change presentation, but no arrangement-generation operation preserves melody/lyrics/identity under benchmark constraints.

B09.reason: Runtime explicitly marks stem separation unavailable.

B10.reason: Pablo reads local state and emits deterministic tips; it does not execute arbitrary natural-language audio edits.

B11.reason: Non-destructive revisions exist, but sequential generative local edits with continuity preservation do not.

B12.reason: Local WAV master render/export exists, but benchmark-required stem export is not yet implemented in the canonical runtime.

promotion_rule: Partial readiness is not a benchmark pass. A test becomes scorable only after its full required operation produces retained output evidence against the frozen inputs.
